meta.opportunity: Flexibility as Energy Company's next asset class

opportunity.background: Energy Company aggregates EV charging — next, heat and industrial assets — into a virtual power plant, selling flexibility into Nordic markets while guaranteeing every car is charged by departure. Thesis: capacity is the supply, margin is the monetization, trust is the license.
opportunity.current_situation: Nordic capacity and volatility are both at record levels; transmission is delayed and battery capex keeps rising. Energy Company has 200,000+ EV customers in reach and a 4,218-vehicle pilot delivering 8.4 MW and €312K net savings YTD. Next 12–24 months decide Nordic flex market share.
business_challenges: Monetizing flexibility without tariff increases or rate cases
Making retail-scale assets bankable for the desk and TSOs
Protecting social license as dispatch events grow
Avoiding disconnected point solutions as the program expands
Proving delivered value against credible counterfactual baselines

audience_readout.mix: Seven executives, no operational audience. Four of seven skew IT/data; no confirmed champion or EVP budget owner.
audience_readout.pitch_to: Open and close at executive altitude. Four of seven are IT/data leaders, so the foundation story runs second, right after the opening frame. If time compresses, keep Loops 1, 2, and 3.
emphasize: New EBITDA line, no tariff increase
Pattern reuses for heat, hydro flex
avoid: Architecture Q&A in the main flow
audience_readout.blocker_sequencing: Mäkinen is the likely blocker. Address with Loop 5's audit trail and Loop 6's lineage-first foundation, then invite him as Phase-1 co-sponsor; park deep architecture for a follow-up.

value_hypothesis.summary: Today's pilot figures (4,218 EVs, 8.4 MW, €312K YTD, €42/customer, 94–96% delivery) are demonstrated; 100,000-EV scale is a hypothesis.
assumptions: ~2 kW average orchestrable flexibility per enrolled EV
Enrollment scales toward 100,000 EVs with opt-out at or below 1%
One district-heating boiler adds 20–30 MW near-zero-CAC flexibility
value_hypothesis.value_math: 100,000 EVs × ~2 kW ≈ 200 MW, plus 20–30 MW from one boiler. At €89K–285K/MW/yr, roughly €18M–€57M/yr gross value.
value_hypothesis.risk_reduction: The closed loop runs today, so Phase-1 risk shrinks to data wiring and market onboarding.
value_hypothesis.executive_ask: Confirm the capacity–margin–trust scorecard, name first data sources to wire, and name IT/business co-sponsors this quarter.

value_pyramid.team_outcome: Executives grasp the portfolio as one dispatchable asset

agenda.headline: 100,000 cars and one boiler become your next power plant
agenda.tell_setup: Flexibility is the one lever that scales with renewables. I'll open with a two-minute portfolio story, so you can size the prize before we prove the machinery.

steps: One EV charging overnight — say: everything that follows is just this, multiplied.
Scroll to 100,000 EVs, ~200 MW, on an ordinary day, no storm.
A district-heating boiler backs down inside the same envelope.
Land on the hypothesis revenue range with every car still charged on time.

agenda.tell_anchor: Every orchestrated MW is capex you don't buy. The rest of today proves it's running machinery, not a concept.

agenda.headline: A pattern, not a project: one foundation carries every phase
agenda.tell_setup: Everything you're about to see runs off one shared, governed foundation. I'll trace it now, so you can judge every proof point against that single-foundation claim.

steps: Vehicle telematics, meters, prices, and weather converge into one store.
Watch a euro on the P&L trace back to a single dispatch interval.
Say: heat, batteries, and the boiler slot onto this, unbuilt from scratch.

agenda.tell_anchor: One foundation, not four projects — that's why heat and hydro-adjacent flex arrive in months, not years.

agenda.headline: Turn 100,000 customers into one number the desk can sell
agenda.tell_setup: A fleet is bankable only if the desk knows deliverable megawatts now, with confidence. I'll show today's live desk view, so you can see enrollment become a market-grade asset.

steps: Watch the desk's live number move as cars plug in for the evening.
Say: every enrolled customer sits inside this single, current figure.
The 48-hour band narrows toward delivery — say: this is what we bid.

agenda.tell_anchor: Confidence bands turn customers into capacity a TSO will pay for — that's what makes 200,000 customers investable.

agenda.headline: A new earnings line with no tariff increase, no rate case
agenda.tell_setup: This margin survives a board only if every euro traces to settlement. I'll walk one event bid to bank, so you can see it audited like generation revenue.

steps: Watch one bid clear into a Nordic balancing product at its price.
Open that event: say, here's the delivered variance, hidden from no one.
Land on €312K net YTD at €42 pilot cost per customer per year.

agenda.tell_anchor: A new EBITDA line needing no tariff increase or new asset — and one you can defend to the board and regulator.

agenda.headline: 0.4% opt-out: the social license that lets this scale
agenda.tell_setup: One bad dispatch headline can cap enrollment for years. I'll show what the customer sees, so you can judge whether this earns trust at 200,000 customers.

steps: Watch charging quietly shift off the €350/MWh evening spike overnight.
Say: €2.12 saved, car guaranteed ready by 07:30, no exceptions.
Say: one tap overrides any of it — the customer never loses control.

agenda.tell_anchor: 0.4% opt-out proves the social license is holding — the scarce asset in this market, not the technology.

agenda.headline: Run it in minutes, defend it for seven years
agenda.tell_setup: Scale multiplies what can go wrong — over-dispatch, an unexplainable settlement. I'll show the command view, so you can grow without growing governance risk.

steps: Open a fairness flag on five over-dispatched customers, pre-modelled.
Say: you see the trade-off and the exact message before you commit.
Say: every action is tamper-proof and traceable for seven years.

agenda.tell_anchor: Fairness and auditability let you say yes to growth — governance here enables speed instead of braking it.

benefit_by_altitude.operational: A flagged decision to review, not a screen to babysit — the trade-off is already modelled for you.
benefit_by_altitude.managerial: Scale the program without scaling headcount — exceptions surface themselves, resolved in minutes.
benefit_by_altitude.executive: Growth capped by data quality alone, never by governance risk — a board that trusts the scorecard.
